description: This Swift source file defines a hotkey-based push-to-talk voice capture system for macOS. It includes classes for monitoring keyboard events (specifically the right Option key) to trigger speech recognition, manages speech recognition sessions using Apple's Speech framework, and handles related audio input configuration, overlay updates, and session finalization.

classes.name: VoicePushToTalkHotkey
classes.description: Manages global and local keyboard event monitoring for the right Option key to trigger push-to-talk voice recognition sessions.

classes.name: VoicePushToTalk
classes.description: Handles speech recognition sessions, audio input configuration, and finalization logic for push-to-talk voice recording.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables monitoring of the hotkey.

methods.name: startMonitoring
methods.description: Sets up global and local event monitors to listen for flag changes corresponding to the hotkey.

methods.name: stopMonitoring
methods.description: Removes event monitors and resets modifier state.

methods.name: handleFlagsChanged
methods.description: Handles flag change events and updates modifier state accordingly.

methods.name: withMainThread
methods.description: Executes a given block asynchronously on the main thread.

methods.name: updateModifierState
methods.description: Updates internal state based on the modifier flags and keyCode, triggers speech recognition start or stop.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Starts a speech recognition session, handling permission checks, configuration, and microphone setup.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Ends the ongoing speech recognition session, finalizes the captured transcript.

methods.name: startRecognition
methods.description: Initializes and starts Apple's speech recognition engine and input pipeline.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes transcriptions received from speech recognition, updating overlays and internal state.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the speech session, sends or displays the final transcript, and cleans up resources.

methods.name: makeConfig
methods.description: Creates and returns the current speech recognition configuration based on app state.
